transcript: What is it like going to see Cabaret at the Kit Kat Club? Cabaret is one of my favorite musicals I have seen many productions but I've never seen anything quite like this cause while yes it's an incredible production of Cabaret it is also an entire experience. It’s at the August Wilson Theatre but it is transformed and unrecognizable. it is completely immersive it literally feels like you’ve been transported to Berlin with multiple stages and multiple bars. You'll notice there's no photos or videos from inside the theater because they give you a sticker to put over your phone camera which is hard because I wanted to take videos of literally everything but I kinda loved it because I got to just take in everything and explore. I definitely recommend getting there early. You literally enter through an alleyway on the side of the theater and if you're over the age of 21 they give you a shot of cherry brandy. Then you just have time to look around and experience the pre show or head to your seat. I've seen the show from three different places I sat at the tables in London I sat in Mez 4 the New Mez last time I was here and this time I was in Mez 3 and this theater is just set up to have an incredible view from every single scene this is truly one of the most unique theater experiences I've ever had and I'm so thankful I was invited to come back and see it again
